notes.hook: The paradox of dead stars building worlds is a solid conceptual hook.
notes.clarity: Effectively translates a complex astrophysical study into a digestible narrative.
notes.payoff: The reveal of a second-generation planet raining metals provides a strong resolution.
notes.visuals: The use of a corporate office building and incorrect star classification is jarring.
notes.loop: The transition from building new ones back to the hook is highly seamless.
